title: Payday loan websites barred in English libraries for first time
author: Ian Anstice / The Library Campaign

editorial.text: The barring of payday loan sites, websites perfectly legal in the UK, has gone ahead in Cheshire East. It is the first council in England to do so and the third in the UK (Dundee did the same last December). While there are probably not multitudes who love such websites, it does raise the question of what may get barred next. Such sites are, of course, perfectly legal in the UK. Of course, UK libraries already bar porn sites (unlike their US counterparts) so the precedent has already been there fo quite a while … but it will be interesting to see what next, if anything, gets barred and for what reason.
